more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Ascorbic acid is used as an antioxidant in food. Its technological role is to slow oxidation in food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat), peeled cut and shredded fruit and vegetables, frozen fruit and vegetables, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern at reported food uses.
Animal studies showed little toxicity even at high doses.
